draft.title: The end of the monarchy
card: In June 1791 Louis XVI and his family tried to flee Paris in secret. They were stopped at Varennes and brought back. Many French people now doubted that the king supported the revolution.
In April 1792 France declared war on Austria. Early defeats led many to suspect the king and queen of siding with the enemy.
On 10 August 1792 a Parisian crowd attacked the Tuileries palace, and the Assembly suspended the king. The monarchy fell and France became a republic a few weeks later.
Louis XVI was put on trial as a traitor to the nation. He was found guilty and executed by guillotine in January 1793.
draft.remember: The flight lost the king's trust, the war turned that distrust into attack, and the republic ended with his execution.

a.q: Why did the king's attempted flight in 1791 weaken the monarchy?
opts: It made many people doubt he backed the revolution
It showed that he had joined the Austrian army
It led the Assembly to abolish the monarchy at once
It caused France to declare war on Austria that week
a.why: By trying to escape in secret, Louis made many French people doubt his loyalty to the revolution. The monarchy did not end at once: it fell over a year later, after the war began and the Tuileries was attacked.
a.clue: Think about what secret flight suggested about his loyalty.

b.q: Why did France's early defeats in the war with Austria in 1792 help bring down the monarchy?
opts: They made many suspect the king and queen backed the enemy
They forced the king to give up his throne to Austria
They showed that a republic could not win a war
They led the Assembly to put the king on trial that month
b.why: Defeats fed suspicion that the royal family sided with Austria, which led to the attack on the Tuileries on 10 August 1792. The trial came later, after the monarchy had already fallen.
b.clue: Ask who people blamed for the defeats.

a.best: It made many people doubt he backed the revolution

b.best: They made many suspect the king and queen backed the enemy

problems.detail: "the republic ended with his execution" literally says the republic ended, which is false. The republic continued after January 1793. It should say something like "the monarchy's fall ended with his execution" or "the new republic executed him".

check.summary: The card's facts and both questions are sound. The remember line's phrase "the republic ended with his execution" wrongly suggests the republic ended in 1793 and should be reworded.
